method: Visual inspection of all five original illustrations and native-component window overlays; not Photoshop output validation.
summary: All faces readable. Three weapon-fit blockers before production: Brindor hammer, Asteran tip, Ornelle sceptre. Keryn staff partially occluded but main action remains visible. Tazrik passes component preview.

cards.weapon: Staff upper end and parts of shaft meet left rail; staff-gripping hand partly occluded. Rope-gripping hand, rope and dock action remain readable.
cards.action: Docking pose, two arms and black raven identity clear.
cards.nextStep: Parent native preview: preserve rope hand/face; decide whether partial utility staff is acceptable. No automatic art edit.

cards.weapon: Hammer head and much of the handle are behind the bottom-right faction flag. Door-bracing hand also meets right rail.
cards.action: Seed jar, protective posture and emotion remain clear.
cards.nextStep: Move weapon inward through an approved art recomposition or a proven native fit. Do not hide/reduce the locked UI to solve it.

cards.weapon: Sword is straight and readable, but distal blade/tip enters the lower-right faction flag. Confirmed in native-window composite.
cards.action: Two-handed grip and broken chain visible.
cards.nextStep: Parent/Einstein native fit check; tip must be kept inward from the flag without bending sword or moving locked components.

cards.weapon: Sceptre head and upper shaft fall behind the left rail; the lower shaft alone is insufficient weapon identification.
cards.action: Root-working hand, doe face and bridge readable.
cards.nextStep: Bring sceptre head and holding hand inward via approved recomposition or demonstrated native fit; preserve female Cerelf identity and root action.

cards.weapon: Three copper projectile spheres, catching hands and electrical cue visible inside rails.
cards.action: Tiger anatomy, balance on barrel and joyful expression readable.
